Fairchild Channel F is a second-generation home video game console; first console that uses programmable cartridges.
First released in North America in November 1976 and discontinued in 1983.
Made by Fairchild Camera and Instrument Co.
About 350,000 units were sold.
It was succeeded by the Fairchild Channel F System II.
Processors include the Fairchild F8.
